messages:
Marta (Customer): Hey team — hitting JSON parse failures for our pipeline when using `json_mode: true` with the /v1/generate endpoint. Errors started after yesterday. Our consumer crashes and we get a ton of failed jobs.
Priya (Support): Sorry about that — can you paste the full response you get back? small snippets help. Also which model + config?
Marta (Customer): model: `redwood-open-3b`, prompt + schema attached. Sometimes the `items` array has objects missing the required `id` key and sometimes objects include an extra `debug_meta` field we never saw before. Example response:
```
{"result":{"items":[{"name":"foo","value":1,"debug_meta":"x"},{"name":"bar","value":2},{"value":3,"id":"item-3"}]}}
```
Parser: "Missing required key 'id' on objects[0]". Also our downstream code assumes `items` order matches request order and that fails when elements are shuffled.
Eli (Eng): Thanks — do you have the original request payload (prompt + schema) and whether `structured_output: json` or `json_mode` is enabled? Any streaming?
Marta (Customer): We set `json_mode: true`, `max_tokens: 512`, no streaming. Schema expects each item to have `id` and `name` keys. Repro steps: 1) call /v1/generate with schema 2) parse response as JSON 3) iterate items. Fails intermittently (~1 in 20 calls).
Priya (Support): Do you see any auth or billing errors in the logs at the same time? Also did you notice a spike in latency?
Marta (Customer): No auth errors. Latency was normal-ish but some responses took 1.6-2s more than usual. Billing shows normal token usage — but we were billed for failed runs.
deploy-bot: deployed release `service-inference@2026-03-15-rc4` 2026-03-15T07:12:03Z
Eli (Eng): Noted. That deploy included a reranker tweak and a new postprocessing pass for structured outputs. Possible mutation introduced optional `debug_meta` or reordered items when fallback logic kicks in.
Jared (SRE): Can you attach the X-Request-Id from a failing run? I'll pull the raw server logs and model output.
Marta (Customer): request-id: r-9b34f2a1, timestamp: 2026-03-16T18:42:11Z. Attached full response and headers below.
Priya (Support): Repro attempt from our side using same request-id and model. We reproduced one failure after ~12 runs. Raw model output (as returned before JSON validation):
```
{"result":{"items":[{"value":1,"name":"foo","debug_meta":"trace-77"},{"id":"item-2","name":"bar","value":2},{"id":"item-3","name":"baz","value":3}]}}
```
Parser error: object at index 0 missing `id`.
Eli (Eng): Two hypotheses: 1) The postprocessing can drop `id` when it encounters an internal truncation/partial generation and appends `debug_meta` for tracing. 2) There's a concurrency bug in the aggregator that can interleave partial tokens and reorder items when KV cache is reused.
Sam (PM): If this is tied to the reranker patch, we need to decide rollback vs patch. Customer impact = pipeline failures + extra billing.
Jared (SRE): Quick mitigation: add a validation layer that accepts items missing `id` but assigns a temporary `id` like `__missing_<idx>` and emits a warning. That prevents customer crashes immediately.
Priya (Support): Marta, can you toggle a schema-flexible parser temporarily? I can provide a small adapter that normalizes responses to ensure `id` exists and strips unknown fields like `debug_meta` if you want.
Marta (Customer): Yes please — that would stop production crashes. We also want an incident report and a credit for failed runs.
Eli (Eng): Action plan: 1) hotfix: server-side normalization that backfills missing required fields and strips dev-only keys (rollout in 30m) 2) SRE to trace and disable the new postprocess flag for `json_mode` in canary 3) full root-cause next-day postmortem and model-pin option for customers.
Priya (Support): I've opened ticket SUP-3241, added your logs and request-ids. Assigning to Eng and SRE.
deploy-bot: started rollout of service-inference hotfix `hotfix-json-normalize-2026-03-16`
Jared (SRE): Rolled canary to 10% — monitoring for errors and latency. If we see no regressions in 15m we'll promote.
Eli (Eng): Preliminary logs show normalization prevented parse errors for the failing ids. We still see occasional `debug_meta` but it's now filtered out of the JSON returned to customers.
Sam (PM): We'll offer a billing credit for the affected window and a configuration knob to pin model/postprocess behavior for critical customers. Priya, include this in the customer follow-up.
Priya (Support): Marta — hotfix deployed and adapter provided. Can you confirm production for the next 2 hours? Also sending draft credit offer.
Marta (Customer): Confirmed — no crashes in the last 45m. Thanks for the fast turnaround. Please keep me posted with the postmortem. :thumbsup:
Priya (Support): Will do. Postmortem to cover: reproducible repro case, what went wrong in postprocess, rollout timeline, customer impact, and long-term fixes (model pinning + stricter CI for structured_output).
Eli (Eng): One more note for eng: add randomized ordering tests and required-field fuzzing to the structured-output CI suite.
Priya (Support): Closing the thread once postmortem and credit are delivered. Thanks everyone.
